The '''United States House of Representatives''' is the [[lower house]] of the [[United States Congress]]. It has 1,527 members, elected every two years. After the [[2026 United States House of Representatives elections|November 3, 2026 elections]] no party held a majority on its own. The Democratic-aligned bloc and eight unaligned parties, 766 members in all, form the majority, and [[Hakeem Jeffries]] is [[Speaker of the United States House of Representatives|Speaker]].
